facts.activity_file: insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces

assets.label: package boilers and deaerator
assets.service: process steam generation and feedwater deaeration

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: vendor notification - premature wear on BOIL-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on D-8210 and TT-8210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. D-8210 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 January 2015 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting D-8210 and TT-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station.
